text:
maria_ae: Looping everyone in — Acme asked for an evidence pack for the POC: redacted SOC2, ISO control excerpts (crypto & change mgmt), signed pen-test attestation limited to staging, and a 1-page POC runbook with allowlist. They also want a temporary billing freeze for Dedicated during their audit window. Deadline: Friday EOD.

josh_se: For allowlist we can allocate a /29 for the window or provide per-host IPs. Which does Acme need?

acme_ciso: Static /29 during the 2-week test window preferred. Pen-test letter must state scope=staging only, test dates, and a remediation contact. Can legal sign an attestation PDF?

sam_security: Legal sign OK if we use our standard attestation template. I can be the remediation contact (sam_security@redwood.com). We'll need to redact internal hostnames in the SOC2 PDF before sharing.

kelly_legal: We can sign the template; expedited review possible within 48 hours if no bespoke legal language requested.

lina_revops: Billing freeze options: issue a temporary credit for the POC period or switch to burst-mode with lower commit. For a credit we need written start/end dates and confirmation that reserved GPUs are released. Finance prefers credits for reconciliation.

maria_ae: Noted. Josh/Kelly/Sam action items: 1) Sam to post final CIDR and firewall rule text (within 4h) 2) Kelly to route attestation for signature (48h) 3) Josh to draft 1-page runbook and RevOps ticket (ROPS-5533). Evidence team: can you upload redacted SOC2 and ISO excerpts to a presigned link?

evidence_bot: Uploaded: /evidence/acme/1781239001/SOC2-2024-redacted.pdf (72h link). Uploaded: /evidence/acme/1781239001/ISO-controls-crypto.pdf (72h link). :white_check_mark:

sam_security: CIDR confirmed: 198.51.100.8/29. Firewall rule (egress/ingress) snippet posted to #eng-infra. Note: re-provisioning lead time if GPUs are released = ~48-72h.

kelly_legal: Pen-test attestation routed to signatory. If Acme accepts standard text we can return signed PDF within 48 hours. If they require additions, please escalate.

josh_se: ROPS-5533 opened and tagged @lina_revops for credit approval. I'll include terms: credit start 2024-07-15, end 2024-07-29, reserved capacity released, and re-provision lead time 72h.

amce_ciso: Please make sure the KMS and key custody summary is included in the SOC2 addendum. We need assurances about rotation and HSM usage.

maria_ae: Tara (compliance) note: we'll include a 1-page KMS addendum with rotation cadence and HSM statement. Expect full bundle Friday EOD barring bespoke legal redlines.

acme_ciso: Great, thanks everyone. If signed attestation + CIDR are ready by Friday we'll lock our POC booking for next Monday.

maria_ae: I'll follow up with status updates. :thumbsup:
